title: Zeus Iceborn Vapor Cooling Device
description:
Version 3 now in stock

The ZEUS Iceborn™ is a cutting-edge cooling and filtration accessory designed to elevate your vaporizing experience with smoother, cooler draws. At its core, the Iceborn uses an innovative ice chamber that cools vapor significantly by filling it with water and freezing it overnight. This process reduces harshness and irritation, ensuring consistently enjoyable sessions without sacrificing flavor. Its compatibility is enhanced by five included adapter sizes—10mm, 12mm, 14mm, 16mm, and 18mm—allowing it to connect effortlessly to a wide range of vaporizers.

For added refinement, the Iceborn supports optional water filtration via a 5ml syringe that lets you precisely add water to the heat exchanger tube, filtering out residual impurities for a cleaner vaporizing experience. A built-in water tray efficiently collects condensation during use, keeping your setup clean and hassle-free. Compact and freezer-ready, the Iceborn is made from durable materials that withstand freezing temperatures, with a secure quick-lock lid ensuring it stays in place during the freezing process, making it ready to deliver chilled vapor on demand.

Includes:
– ZEUS Iceborn V3™
– Glass Mouthpiece
– Adapter (1X 14-10MM)
– Adapter (1X 16-12MM)
– Main adapter (18MM)
– Short Whips (sizes small and medium)
– 5ML Syringe
